finding.label: duplication
finding.failure_mode: The five required pack-section headings and the exact-match grep check against them are re-declared independently here instead of reusing the identical list already in build-artifacts.sh; a future edit to the pack format contract applied to only one of the two copies makes build-artifacts.sh (warn-and-continue) and validate-pack.sh (hard-fail) disagree on whether the same pack is valid.
